```{r}
pacman::p_load(tmap, SpatialAcc, sf, tidyverse, knitr)

tmap_mode("plot")

mpsz      <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "MP14_SUBZONE_NO_SEA_PL")
hexagons  <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "hexagons")
eldercare <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "ELDERCARE")

mpsz      <- st_transform(mpsz, 3414)
hexagons  <- st_transform(hexagons, 3414)
eldercare <- st_transform(eldercare, 3414)

eldercare <- eldercare %>% select(fid, ADDRESSPOS) %>% mutate(capacity = 100)
hexagons  <- hexagons %>% select(fid) %>% mutate(demand = 100)

ODMatrix <- read_csv("data/aspatial/OD_Matrix.csv")

distmat_wide <- ODMatrix %>%
  select(origin_id, destination_id, total_cost) %>%
  arrange(origin_id, destination_id) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = destination_id, values_from = total_cost, names_sort = TRUE)

distmat_mat <- distmat_wide %>%
  column_to_rownames("origin_id") %>%
  as.matrix()

distmat_km <- distmat_mat / 1000

mapex <- st_bbox(hexagons)

powers <- c(0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5)

acc_list <- lapply(powers, function(p) {
  out <- data.frame(ac(
    hexagons$demand,
    eldercare$capacity,
    distmat_km,
    power  = p,
    family = "Hansen"
  ))
  colnames(out) <- "accHansen"
  as_tibble(out)
})

maps <- purrr::imap(acc_list, function(acc_df, i) {
  hex_tmp <- bind_cols(hexagons, acc_df)
  tm_shape(hex_tmp, bbox = mapex) +
    tm_polygons(fill = "accHansen",
                fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                  style = "quantile",
                  n = 10,
                  values = "brewer.blues")) +
    tm_shape(eldercare) +
    tm_dots(size = 0.3, fill = "red", col = "black") +
    tm_title(paste0("Accessibility to eldercare: Hansen (power = ", powers[i], ")")) +
    tm_layout(frame = TRUE) +
    tm_compass(type = "8star", size = 2) +
    tm_scalebar() +
    tm_grid(alpha = 0.2)
})

invisible(lapply(maps, print))

```
